PCGen exports the Display ~ <skill> record (scr_skills.lst, VISIBLE:EXPORT, no ACHECK), which mirrors only the base skill's ranks, so the base skill's armor check penalty (ACHECK:YES, scr_skills.lst:6 Acrobatics) never reaches the exported total. SRD: Acrobatics, Athletics and Stealth take the armor check penalty (https://www.aonsrd.com/Skills.aspx?ItemName=All; https://www.aonsrd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=87 Reading Armor Tables). The engine's figure is the SRD hand value (artifacts/epic_0/seed-hand-values.md, reviewed agree).

PCGen's VAR.Fly 60 adds the internal Drone Flight System's fly to the hover chassis' BONUS:VAR|Fly|30 (scr_abilities.lst:1394); SRD hover drone: Speed 30 feet, fly 30 feet (perfect), initial mods flight system (x2, included in its speed) (https://www.aonsrd.com/DroneChassis.aspx?ItemName=All). The engine prints Fly 30 ft. (E5.4 receipt).
Drones do not have Stamina Points (https://www.aonsrd.com/Classes.aspx?ItemName=Drone): the engine prints no Stamina line, PCGen exports ALTHP 0. None and 0 agree.
